env.example:
# Script variables for `hpy happyview dev`. Copy this file to .env, which git
# ignores, and scripts read each line as ctx.env.<KEY>. A deployed instance
# takes them from its own settings or environment instead.
# EXAMPLE_API_KEY=
hello.lua:
-- Answers com.example.hello. Save this file and the next request runs it.
-- The annotations name types `hpy happyview dev` writes into .happyview/types.

---@param input lexicons.com.example.hello.Params
---@param ctx happyview.QueryCtx
---@return lexicons.com.example.hello.Output
function handle(input, ctx)
  return { message = "Hello, " .. (input.name or "world") .. "!" }
end
procedure.lua:
local log = require("internal.logging")
local record = require("happyview.record")

function handle(input, ctx)
  local ref = record.create("COLLECTION", input)
  log.info("record saved", { uri = ref.uri })
  return { uri = ref.uri, cid = ref.cid }
end
query.lua:
local log = require("internal.logging")
local db = require("happyview.db")

function handle(input, ctx)
  log.info("handling query", { uri = input.uri })

  if input.uri then
    local entry = db.get(input.uri)
    if not entry then
      return { error = "NotFound", message = "no record at " .. input.uri }
    end
    return { uri = entry.uri, cid = entry.cid, value = entry.record }
  end

  -- Query params arrive as strings unless the lexicon types them, and a
  -- chain step given nil is skipped, so absent filters read as no filter.
  return db.records("COLLECTION")
    :did(input.did)
    :limit(tonumber(input.limit))
    :cursor(input.cursor)
    :run()
end
